lines.2: 「Well, we're heading home for the night.」
lines.8: 「Ahaha! You're so innocent and cute right now, Leo!」
lines.9: For some reason, Crab happily clung to me.
lines.11: 「If you were always like this, I'd let you become my underling. What a shame.」
lines.12: 「For some reason, I get more self-conscious at night.」
lines.13: 「Didn't being around a beauty like me build up your resistance?」
lines.14: 「Being around you only built up my resistance to puppies.」
lines.16: It meant I could tolerate one yapping at me to play. That was all.
lines.17: 「Crab aside, it's because you've never had a woman here this late, right?」
lines.19: 「Separate floors. Keep your mind as still and clear as a polished mirror, innocent young man.」
lines.22: After saying whatever they pleased, they left.
lines.25: 「What are you going to do with your adult books? And the games too. Want me to hold on to them?」
lines.27: 「You don't have that many, but you'll be in trouble if she finds them.」
lines.28: 「Good point. Sorry, but would you? Just until the first room inspection is over.」
lines.31: 「Just remember that you owe me one.」
lines.32: Fukahire snatched the books from me and went home cradling them like treasure.
lines.33: 「They could tell me not to think about it, but...」
lines.34: During the day, I had even talked about the thrill of being alone together.
lines.35: At night, being alone together felt awkward. I grew nervous despite myself.
lines.36: Otome was right. I really was a chicken.
lines.37: I was thirsty, so I headed downstairs for a drink.
lines.39: A voice was coming from the bathroom.
lines.43: She was singing in the bath?!
lines.44: She had only just moved in!
lines.46: She really was no ordinary person.
